title: HVAC and Plumbing in Selma, TX
desc: Rosenberg Plumbing and Air offers services for HVAC and plumbing in Selma, TX and the surrounding areas. Call today for fast service!

blocks.text: In Selma, TX, Rosenberg Plumbing & Air takes care of HVAC and plumbing issues that interrupt your daily comfort. From a furnace that won’t ignite to a stubborn leak under the sink, our technicians and plumbers handle repairs, replacements, and routine maintenance. We work on air conditioners, heaters, pipes, and fixtures of all kinds. Every home gets the attention it needs to keep running smoothly through every season, so don’t hesitate to give our team a call when problems arise. With decades of combined experience, we bring dependable solutions backed by a commitment to quality service.

When temperatures climb, most people expect immediate relief at the thermostat. That comfort depends on clean filters, clear coils, and balanced airflow. Without regular care, HVAC systems lose efficiency, driving up utility bills and straining equipment until failure becomes inevitable.

At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, our HVAC services in Selma are designed to keep you ahead of those problems. We provide seasonal tune-ups, responsive repair service, and complete system replacements when your equipment has reached the end of its life. Our Comfort Club makes it simple to stay on track with reminders, priority scheduling, and discounts that keep your system reliable year-round. Steady performance means your home stays cool during long Texas summers and warm during sudden cold snaps that catch homeowners by surprise. Regular maintenance also extends equipment lifespan, lowers energy costs, and helps avoid expensive emergency repairs.

Our technicians are trained on all makes and models, from traditional central systems to ductless mini-splits and advanced heat pumps. Whether your system needs a minor adjustment or a full replacement, you can count on honest recommendations and detailed work every step of the way. Financing options are available on approved credit to make upgrades more affordable when it’s time for a new unit.

Every household relies on plumbing that works quietly in the background. Running water makes cooking, cleaning, and bathing possible, while slow drains, hidden leaks, or water heater problems can quickly disrupt daily routines. Addressing these issues early prevents extensive water damage and keeps your system dependable.

At Rosenberg Plumbing & Air, our plumbing services in Selma cover everything from small repairs to major replacements. Our skilled plumbers arrive prepared to handle leaks, clogs, or fixture installations with precision. We also use advanced tools like video camera inspections to diagnose hidden problems accurately, saving you both time and money. If your home needs repiping, sewer repair, or slab leak service, we deliver lasting solutions that restore confidence in your plumbing system.

Consistent care is the most effective way to keep plumbing reliable. Our plumbing maintenance program provides annual water heater flushes, leak detection, and discounts on repairs to catch problems before they escalate. Homeowners benefit from predictable service, fewer surprises, and lower water waste. When emergencies strike, our 24/7 availability means help is only a phone call away.
